The game currently offers only two chapters—just one more than the demo released months ago. Unfortunately, I found little distinction between them, with the Chapter 2 boss fight feeling mechanically weaker than the one in Chapter 1. While the gameplay itself can be enjoyable, it raises concerns about whether the developers can sustain creativity and deliver more engaging mechanics as the game develops. Additionally, there are several notable issues: 1. The game crashed for our entire team during the Chapter 2 final boss encounter. 2. There's no checkpoint system, which feels out of place in a game intended to be relaxing. If the team wipes at any point, we are forced to restart from the beginning. This also means there's no way to save progress, requiring players to finish the game in one sitting. 3. Managing light levels feels overly demanding—the meter depletes too quickly, and we had to constantly add wood to the fire, making it difficult to focus on other aspects of the game. 4. There’s a lack of indicators for incoming events, such as the next wave of enemies or obstacles like giant rocks blocking the road ahead, which led to unnecessary frustration when our cart was suddenly smashed into pieces by a brute jumping over or by a giant rock on the path. 5. The interaction logic for picking up and delivering items could use improvement. The most frustrating issue is that when trying to pick up a second item from the ground while already holding one, we sometimes accidentally throw away the first item instead because the second item is out of interaction range. Overall, while the concept shows promise, these shortcomings make it hard to recommend at this stage.

“喵门镖局”，一款休闲类动作游戏。刚看到评分时，我还是有点慌得，但上手意外的不错。画风非常清新。玩法还是比较新奇的，玩家将扮演镖师小猫，护送我们的木制马车穿越危险的地图。白天，我们需要收集资源，木头，草药，金钱，并清理马车路上的障碍；晚上，各种土匪便会倾巢而出，此时需要我们点燃篝火，消耗资源，抵御侵略。 在旅程中，我们会遇到不同的分叉路口，可以选择困难但资源多的，为后续旅程积累资源；也可以选择风险小的，休闲发展。但总的来说，我觉得整体难度都不大。除了事件，游戏中还有商店，休息点，在这些地方我们可以为角色，货车升级，加强能力，丰富构筑。货车升级多为机制类，像可以加装炮台，图腾等等；而角色升级多为数值类，像跳的更高，更耐揍，打人更疼等等。 到了关底，马车会在一旁等我们，而我们则需要与高难boss搏斗，此时又成了动作游戏。boss的血比较厚，但机制并不复杂，也没有二阶段。只要摸清机制，适时偷刀，boss还是比较容易攻克的。攻克完后，我们便可领取奖励，进入下一张地图。 但遗憾的是，游戏目前仍处于ea阶段，内容是在过少。目前本作只有两章，且敌人的攻击方式有些大同小异。不高的难度给不了我构筑的紧迫感，小怪基本割草解决。在构筑和升级上，本作总给我一种浅尝辄止的感觉，小猫的动作到最后也是砍砍砍，马车的构筑也显得不耐玩，没有那种构筑终于完成的爽感。所以在新鲜感褪去后，我开始有了种重复枯燥，想要赶紧到下一关的冲动。 本作支持1-4人游玩。我是单人游玩，所以有些地方总显得手忙脚乱，比如打完一波敌人后，要收拾战场，要补充物资，要修理马车，要清除障碍，要回收马车掉落的物品。而马车总是匀速滚滚向前，如果不做好抉择，此时便会损失一大堆物资。 故最终我想我只能把本作定义为一个带一定肉鸽动作元素的休闲游戏，而不是肉鸽动作游戏。但游戏目前也在持续更新，有兴趣可以看看官方的更新计划，并考虑是否入股。 [code] [h1]欢迎关注 [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/luanqibajiao]乱七芭蕉[/url][/b] 鉴赏家[/h1] 欢迎各路 [strike]肥宅、哲学家、LSP、绅士[/strike] 大神和小白加入我们：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/luanqibajiao][b]乱七芭蕉[/b][/url] 一起分享乱七芭蕉的 [strike]福利资源[/strike] 游戏经验：[b]Q群774704264[/b] [/code]

Lots of fun to play with friends and family together. I was extremely disappointed that this game did not have any meta progression. That seems like a basic requirement for any rogue-lite as motivation to play through the game more than once or twice. Would also like a slower wood burning time. I forgot if there was an upgrade to slow burn time at the shop, but it definitely feels like a log wood collected is more like a shred of paper. I'd wait for a patch to introduce meta progression as the most important feature. I can hustle for more wood if on our next run we could PERMANENTLY upgrade to a more efficient furnace, chance for extra material drop on harvest, quicker harvest or further throwing distance.

I will leave a positive review, because I think the game has great bones and deserve to have a chance to grow. However, I did not enjoy the current version and do not plan to play the game any further. It lacks content and meta progression. I will wait for an update, or for the release of the game before trying again. On the positive: - The gameplay is Solid and fun. - The theme around following and protecting a caravan is very strong. - The game is very cute and pretty. BUT: - This game has only 3 classes, and each class is only 2 attacks. There are no equipment, gear, or class progression. It gets dull fast. - The difficulty is very high. Effectively, we only saw the first forest over and over and we got bored of it. Either the game isn't balanced for less than 4 players, or the difficulty is too high for a game that tags itself as 'Casual' with cute graphics. It currently does not fit the target audience and needs rebalance, different levels, or difficulty options. - There are no meta progression between run, nor any unlock. - There is no story, no campaign.

Great couch co-op game! I'd recommend at least 3 players for a more balanced and chaotic fun experience, but also since the game is QUITE hard. So, for the players: this is a very hard game, where cooperation is key, mistakes will be made, but when you defeat a boss you feel it very rewarding! Right now it only has a few bosses, but it will take a lot of practice, attention, curiosity, creativity, resilience and teamwork to beat it. On the first try, you will feel like you don't understand anything. So PLEASE play the tutorial first. On the next few tries, you will try to grasp everything the game has to offer. You have to make a lot of choices in a lot of ways, so there is a nice replayability value. Right now, if you plan on grabbing it and playing it with some friends, I'd say wait for a sale. Now for the devs: the game is sometimes too overwhelming on what's going on! lots of enemies on screen and some of their gimmicks you need to learn, so as to not fail miserably, are quite hard to grasp when the screen is full of chaos. For example, the rat and its pole, or the owl (thief). They are quick on what they do, they can screw your run while you are busy dealing with the thousand rabbits beating you, avoiding the hogs, repairing the cart and/or keeping the fire alive. See! there's a LOT to pay attention to. Also, Rosie moves too fast! I know you can slow her down... but now, the environment also has tricky things: the ruins' different patterns, the bushes that you can destroy and follow, the yellow thingie that can give you more of a resource, the totems... Ahhh! just by listing these things I get stressed. That being said, well organized team work is key! ALL of the players must be quick and effective. But, the game will slap you in the face before you realize your mistakes and the workarounds to make the run less painful. There's a lot to take into account, maybe find an easier or quicker way to communicate all of that to the players, or maybe, slow down Rosie a bit? The UI is also a bit crowded in my opinion. So anyway, there's a lot going on and everything happens way too fast, that's my main complain. Some tricks make the game easier, but are hard to figure out. But this is not the player's fault, it all just happens too fast and not everything is obvious. There's just not much room to try and experiment stuff, and mistakes are very punishing. On a side note, the game is cute, specially if you love cats! I mean, you can meow! purr when you sleep! So cute!!! <3 The artstyle is great, the sound effects are also nice and add wackyness to the experience. IDK what else to say. Thanks for reading! Hope the project can grow! It has a lot of potential :D

I'm a gamedev myself, and that's the only review you need [h1]Short description[/h1][hr][/hr] Simple co-op game for 2-4 people. You can play solo, but it's not great for solo play You select a role and start the game. During the playthrough, you must protect your wagon, collect scattered resources around, and buy upgrades [h1]Worth highlighting / What is unique[/h1][hr][/hr] * Path selection. When you reach the end of a node, you must choose one of two paths. Each one has a node type and difficulty modifier (you can reset all difficulty modifiers at camp and earn money for discarding them) * Visuals. They look gorgeous [h1] Overall rating 4/10[/h1][hr][/hr] The game is very simple and shallow. You have only three classes (four with the latest update) that are very similar to each other. During a run you have only eight upgrade types for your wagon as well as about sixteen for your characters There is almost no replayability value, and it becomes a bit boring even at the two-hour mark. The bosses are not very interesting either. The core idea is great, though, and the visuals are amazing. Still I don't think I can recommend it. After all, for this genre, I believe there are much better options in this genre, even if their visuals are worse. It's not terrible, but not good either. [h1]Extra[/h1][hr][/hr] Follow my curator page, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45084582-Dev-inspiration/] Dev inspiration[/url] for more reviews from a developer's perspective.

Wild Woods — ★★★★★ (Recommended) My partner and I have been playing this together for a while now, and it's become one of our go to co-op games. What's impressed us most is watching it grow. New classes, a new region, real updates that actually add something instead of just tweaking numbers. You can tell the devs are putting in consistent work, and it shows. The pace of improvement is honestly what makes us appreciate this game as much as we do. It didn't launch perfect and then coast, it just kept getting better, patch after patch. Boss fights are a highlight too. They actually require you to work together and pay attention instead of just tanking hits, so beating one with your co-op partner feels like a real win. If you're looking for a solid co-op game to play with someone, we'd recommend this one without hesitation. New content keeps it fresh, the fights are satisfying, and it's clear there's real care behind it.

Good. It's especially fun with friends (better to have at least 3 imho) - especially at night game can become chaotic and make you make plans fast. As for the downsides: the game isn't quite finished yet, so be prepared for random bugs here and there; however, since the game features a save system, you can always restart from the recent save - provided you haven't died, of course. Btw If you want a slightly more relaxed playthrough, I recommend choosing the Guardian class as it's currently a bit overbuffed.
